new_partial_epoch6_records.scope: New partial epoch6 only; no repeated epochs1-5/model reload/benchmark. Logged wall time includes the actual initial pause.

protocol.initialization_setting: Fine-tune the published jointly trained XTrack-B reference; this is not an equal-total-training-budget comparison against its original training.
protocol.risk_checks: Each update uses independent augmented training-pool pairs, same evaluation routing conditions before/after; balance and router BCE contribute to the actual training displacement but not localization risk labels.
protocol.sampling: Each rank uses a mixed task batch; global 24 examples contain eight T, eight D, eight E. Balance remains computed over each complete mixed rank batch.
